title: 彩虹為什麼會出現？
style: 明亮日系兒童科普動畫風、色彩飽和、雨後森林空地、戶外木桌、柔和陽光
characters: 小明＝卡其探險帽、棕短髮、綠背心、藍背包；小美＝棕色雙馬尾、粉紅外套、紅格子裙；阿柴＝橘白柯基、綠色葉子領巾；林博士＝白髮白鬍、圓眼鏡、白色實驗袍、綠領帶
no_text_rule: 不要在畫面中出現任何文字、標籤、公式、表格或圖示

voices.小明: 七歲小男孩，稚嫩的童聲，音調很高，天真活潑
voices.小美: 開朗溫柔的十歲女孩，聲音甜美
voices.旁白: 溫柔親切的年輕女性旁白，語速平穩
voices.林博士: 六十多歲的台灣男教授，標準台灣華語口音，沉穩親切，語速慢

ref_text: 大家好，今天天氣真好，我們一起去森林裡看看吧！

ref_transcript.小明: 哇！一隻小小的卵，竟然可以變成這麼美麗的蝴蝶！
ref_transcript.林博士: 不要只看大小，要比較同樣體積裡有多少質量。

no_text_rule_en: No text of any kind may appear in the picture: no letters, labels, numbers, formulas, signs or icons.
style_en: bright Japanese children's science anime, saturated colors, a sunny forest clearing after rain with an outdoor wooden table, soft sunlight; every rainbow has red on the outer edge and violet on the inner edge
characters_en: Xiao Ming (小明) = a boy with a khaki explorer hat with a green leaf badge, short brown hair, a green vest and a blue backpack; Xiao Mei (小美) = a girl with brown twin ponytails, a pink jacket and a red plaid skirt; Ah Chai (阿柴) = an orange-and-white corgi with a green leaf bandana; Dr. Lin (林博士) = a kind old scientist with white hair and beard, round glasses, a khaki explorer hat, a white lab coat and a green tie
